steps.content: [Interrogation Room]
A metallic clang echoes through the room as the door swings open. The soldier chained to the interrogation chair lifts his head.

You recognize him. It's the messenger from this morning. Now, you have a name to put to the face: Shane Alvez. He's a frontline soldier, dispatched directly by the metropoles from WhiteSands with a single objective: to ensure the smooth development of Monolith.

steps.speaker: Hilda
steps.content: Shane Alvez... Let's drop the act. Tell us who you really are, and who you're working for.
He shoots a defiant glare at Hilda, then his eyes flick to you, feigning busywork with your notes. A contemptuous snort is his only reply.

steps.speaker: Shane
steps.content: In your dreams! I'm not saying a damn thing!

steps.speaker: Hilda
steps.content: Is that so? Then take a look at this.
With a stern expression, Hilda places several photos in front of him, informing him that his operation has completely failed and all his teammates have been eliminated.

A wave of crimson fury sweeps up Shane's neck and floods his face. His eyes bulge with uncontainable rage, and he unleashes a blistering tirade, his words devolving into a coarse, incomprehensible Outland language.
Hilda waits, a statue of patience, until his rage spends itself on the sterile room air. Only then does she utter a single, soft word: a city-state name you don't recognize.

steps.speaker: Shane
steps.content: H-how did you know?

steps.speaker: Hilda
steps.content: Language gives you away. You slip back into it when you're emotionally charged.
Hilda speaks softly, as if stirred by a personal memory.

steps.speaker: Hilda
steps.content: I remember that city-state. Your people needed Hypercubes and requested aid from the metropoles. After the agreement was signed, it became a subordinate city to Sevael. That was over a decade ago.

steps.speaker: Shane
steps.content: Ha... Haha... Hahahahahaha!

A sharp, manic laugh is torn from Shane's throat, his shoulders heaving with the violence of it. It's the laugh of a man who has just heard the world's most cruel joke, a sound utterly devoid of warmth, sharpened to a fine edge by pure hatred.

steps.speaker: Shane
steps.content: Yeah, you helped us back then. But how long are we supposed to pay that debt? Ten years? Twenty? For the rest of our damn lives?!

steps.speaker: Shane
steps.content: We grow the finest wheat in all of WhiteSands, but the moment we signed that deal, we lost all say in the price! Every industry we try to build, we have to kneel and ask the metropoles for permission!

steps.speaker: Shane
steps.content: A whole decade gone, and we've got nothing to show for it but wheat... No industry, no development, no future. You use Hypercube rations to keep us on a leash, forcing us to be nothing but your farmers!

This is the inevitable fate of any city-state drained by a metropole. The more one-dimensional its industry, the more anemic it becomes, until it is reduced to a mere blood bag, tethered to its master and forever unable to stand on its own. Faced with this fate—revolutionary upheaval or a slow death by bleeding—it's no wonder they become what the authorities label "separatists."
Hilda must understand this on a visceral level. As you watch her, you see her fists clench, her words becoming rigid and forced as she speaks.

steps.speaker: Hilda
steps.content: The metropole system has its flaws, but it remains the most effective way for human civilization to survive against the catastrophes.
Shane spits forcefully on the ground.

steps.speaker: Shane
steps.content: Keep lying to yourself!

steps.speaker: Shane
steps.content: We believed that too, at first! But what did we get? Half our harvest is taken as tribute, our children who go to the metropoles never come back, wheat prices get worse every year, and if we have a few bad harvests from disasters, they even cut our Hypercube rations the next year!

steps.speaker: Hilda
steps.content: That's impossible. Hypercube allocations for satellite towns are non-negotiable. No one has the authority to reduce them. Where did you hear such lies?

A violent, wheezing laugh erupts from Shane. His chest heaves with the effort, each breath a ragged rasp like a torn bellows. Yet, cutting through that grating sound, his voice is laced with a terrifying, unmistakable excitement.

steps.speaker: Shane
steps.content: Lies? If they were just lies, your parents wouldn't have had to run, would they?
Hilda's expression instantly turns cold.

steps.speaker: Hilda
steps.content: You... what else do you know?
Shane lifts his head, a defiant and twisted smile creeping across his face.

steps.speaker: Shane
steps.content: That person was right about you! This gets under your skin, doesn't it? You're dying to know more!

steps.speaker: Shane
steps.content: Fine, I'll tell you. Ten years ago, a man from a metropole came to my hometown. Said he was secretly researching the real conditions of satellite towns under the metropole system.

steps.speaker: Shane
steps.content: What a dedicated guy! He spent months visiting over a dozen towns like ours. Promised us his wife was a councilor who could definitely bring our situation to the higher-ups.

steps.speaker: Shane
steps.content: He wrote a long report detailing all the flaws and dangers of the metropole system. Warned that both DisCity and the satellite towns were sitting on a powder keg ready to blow!

steps.speaker: Shane
steps.content: Then, well, you know what happened... he got an arrest warrant... branded a traitor... until there was no place left for him in the metropole...

steps.speaker: Hilda
steps.content: Enough!
Hilda lunges to her feet, sensing the damning words about to leave Shane's lips. But his voice explodes over hers, a roar of raw defiance that drowns her out.

steps.speaker: Shane
steps.content: So they went to DisCity! And personally lit the fuse!!
A spasm of agony seizes him, twisting his facial nerves. The manic triumph in his smile warps, contorting into a terrifying, grotesque mask.

steps.speaker: Shane
steps.content: They started the war!

steps.speaker: Shane
steps.content: And their daughter, the one they had to leave behind... got brainwashed into becoming the metropole's most obedient, most loyal dog! Ha! Hahahaha!

steps.speaker: Hilda
steps.content: I said... that's enough!
Hilda's voice shakes, with a low, chilling menace that seems to darken the very air.

steps.speaker: Shane
steps.content: Believe what you want. Either way, you've only got two choices: believe your parents were real traitors, or admit the metropoles are actually a rotting pile of garbage.

steps.speaker: Shane
steps.content: DisCity's the only one who got the spine... to resist being swallowed whole by you people all this time, heh heh... cough cough.
A gleam of undisguised reverence shines in Shane's eyes, the same fanatical gleam Hilda has seen in far more repulsive things.

steps.speaker: Hilda
steps.content: You call that "spine"? DisCity abuses Hypercubes to warp the anomalous power and distort life itself, turning soldiers, even infected civilians, into monsters neither human nor beast, then throwing them onto the battlefield!

steps.speaker: Hilda
steps.content: Even if they win, what kind of twisted victory is that?!

steps.speaker: Shane
steps.content: You made us do it! Don't forget the Nirvana massacre. You ******* bastards have no right to judge anyone!

steps.speaker: Shane
steps.content: The metropoles should've fallen long ago. You people, rotten to the core, just wait to be slaughtered by DisCity!
He descends into manic laughter, vomiting fresh blood with every gasp.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: ...Stop him! He's trying to bite his tongue!

steps.speaker: Hilda
steps.content: Don't you dare die!
With lightning speed, Hilda lunges forward and seizes Shane's jaw, her grip brutal and final.
(Mania Effect)

steps.speaker: Hilda
steps.content: Who organized your group? Who gave you the intel on the secret passages?!

As her own emotions surge, a flash of Mania responds. Black, spike-like shards erupt through her gloves, piercing deep into his jaw. Instantly, the dark sludge recognizes a host. It surges into the wound, a torrent of living shadow rushing down his throat.

Hilda recoils, snatching her hand back as if burned, but the damage is done. Mania has already burrowed upward, shattering his jaw from within and tearing his mouth apart in a grotesque, silent scream.
Under the interrogation room's pitiless white lights, his face is frozen in a monstrous, gaping ruin.

steps.speaker: Inflammatory Voice
steps.content: Hahahaha! How pathetic! You've been so thoroughly deceived! Hahahaha!

steps.speaker: Shane
steps.content: We will have... vengeance... we will be... free... we will destroy... the hegemony...

steps.speaker: Shane
steps.content: We will... have... freedom...

You lunge forward, catching Hilda as her legs give way. The sudden emotional shock has sent her Mania into a violent spiral; now it's turning back on itself, corrupting her from within. Through her palm, grotesque spikes writhe and spread, threatening to consume her entire body.

options: Do you have anomalous power in you?

steps.content: You play dumb, acting as if you're seeing it for the first time.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Stop talking. If you can't control your power, don't use it. Take deep breaths and calm your emotions, or it will pierce right through you.

steps.speaker: Hilda
steps.content: It's okay... I was just... too rash. I'll be fine in a moment...
She brushes your hands away and stumbles back to the chair, her eyes fixed on the viscous, dark sludge before her.

Her gaze is a window to a private torment: the physical agony of the Mania's corruption, the sharp sting of remorse for a life lost to her own lack of control, and—most profoundly—a deep, disorienting bewilderment that threatens to consume her.
In the silence, you offer a quiet thanks to Shane for his brutal, necessary truth. Now, it's time to press Hilda further.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: The question Shane asked you at the end. Your parents or the city-state. Which would you choose to believe?
A shadow falls across Hilda's eyes.

steps.speaker: Hilda
steps.content: I... don't know...
With a soft sigh, you lower yourself beside her and take her hand. Your grip is firm, an attempt to soothe the violent Mania surging through her veins.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: I know it wasn't intentional. You were trying to stop him from killing himself. Your power just slipped beyond your control.
Hilda turns her gaze to you. Her eyes, under the influence of Mania, flicker between clarity and deep, consuming shadows.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: But regret won't change what happened. If you truly feel responsible for what happened to him, then carefully consider everything he said. Don't let emotions cloud your judgment. Don't deny. Don't avoid the difficult questions.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Then... answer his accusations with action.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Since this was your parents' former residence, they might have left documents somewhere even the metropoles' assassins couldn't find. Didn't you say they were resourceful people?

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: The odds are slim, but I still want to search for myself. Come with me.
You hold her gaze, your invitation hanging in the air between you. Slowly, the light returns to her eyes, the lost and avoidant haze giving way to a fragile, but growing, spark.

steps.speaker: Hilda
steps.content: ...You're right. I... I should go look for... whatever truth is there...

steps.speaker: Hilda
steps.content: Thank you... ${PlayerName}. I'll go with you.
